lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with centroids spaced roughly equidistantly along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming a lattice-like pattern where the blobs serve as anchor nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal edge to dark shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 10-12 high-luminance blobs of varying diameters, primarily concentrated in the basal and central regions of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple elongated dark silhouettes (parasitic remoras) attached to the ventral flank and pectoral region; minor irregular notches visible on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin.
